name: search_catalogue
description: Search the agency data catalogue for datasets matching a natural language query. Returns table names, descriptions, classifications, and owners.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g., 'fraud datasets', 'payment history')

name: get_dataset_detail
description: Get full details of a specific dataset including columns, types, descriptions, properties, S3 location, owner, and steward.

name: show_lineage
description: Show data lineage for a dataset: upstream sources, transformation description, and downstream consumers.

table_name.description: Table name to trace lineage for

name: generate_metadata
description: Get a table's schema and properties to generate FAIR-compliant metadata descriptions. Write-back is disabled by default.

table_name.description: Table name to generate metadata for

name: suggest_joins
description: Get all table schemas in the catalogue to recommend joins for an analytical goal.

goal.description: Analytical goal (e.g., 'link fraud referrals to payment history')
